human_policy.definition: AI-only horizontal strokes with up to five cue-ball cushions, high/low and moderate side tips within the existing cue disk. A 3.2 m/s cue-head exploration cap is an engineering choice within the existing 5 m/s manual limit, not a measured player limit or cue-ball speed. Rear-ball interference, near-rail high-tip access and double-hit exclusions remain. Complexity is a soft cost balanced against next-shot quality and landing-zone stability. No forward physics or manual controls are changed.

label_definition: Bounded rollout completion discounted by mean and hardest shot quality: pot tolerance, distance, bridge and soft five-rail/side effort; legal secondary position contacts are allowed with a small contact cost and cluster-release credit. Small clean-entry preference; useful jaw contact allowed. Partial progress credit; not human probability.
